title: OS.get_video_adapter_driver_info returns an array of two empty strings (Linux)
body:
### Tested versions Reproducible in 4.0 stable, 4.1 stable, 4.2 stable, 4.3 stable, 4.4 stable, 4.4.1 stable, 4.5 stable, 4.5.1 stable Seems to affect all 4.x releases ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable - Ubuntu 25.10 25.10 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (RADV GFX1201) - AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.71 GiB memory ### Issue description When the following function is called ```gdscript OS.get_video_adapter_driver_info() ``` on a Linux system (seemingly regardless of the distro), an array with two empty strings is returned: ```["", ""]``` The expected data would be something similar to this: ```["amdgpu", "25.2.7"]```
I originally discovered this bug in 4.5.1 stable, and it seems to affect all 4.x stable releases in both OpenGL and Vulkan. I've tested on Kubuntu 25.10 & 25.04. @kukiric on the Godot Cafe discord server reported the following: > Aurora (based on Fedora 42), Ryzen 7640U, 760M, tested on Godot 4.5.1, two empty strings running in linux, but returns driver info correctly in wine (though I'm not sure what the version 32 thing refers to, my mesa is 25.1.9...)
At https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/platform/linuxbsd/os_linuxbsd.cpp#L465, the engine calls `lspci` to obtain driver information, but (at least for me) lspci does not provide this information. Calling `lspci -d 1002:7550 -vmm` returns the following: ``` Slot: 2d:00.0 Class: VGA compatible controller Vendor: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. [AMD/ATI] Device: Navi 48 [Radeon RX 9070/9070 XT/9070 GRE] SVendor: Sapphire Technology Limited SDevice: Navi 48 XTX [Sapphire Pulse Radeon RX 9070 XT] Rev: c0 ProgIf: 00 IOMMUGroup: 18 ``` ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create any gdscript file 2. Anywhere inside of the file, call: ```gdscript var driverInfo = OS.get_video_adapter_driver_info() print(driverInfo) ``` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
